name: seeking_edge
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the ORIGINAL card illustration and the strict EDIT TARGET. The previous pass only swapped characters and looked plain and standard: this pass must feel INVENTIVE, reinterpreting the replaced subject as a specific Persona 3 Reload moment, character or object, while the card stays instantly recognizable at thumbnail size: same silhouettes, same action, same footprint, same camera. Keep the exact background: its palette, large shapes, lighting direction, cast shadows, magical effects, enemies and core objects stay as in Image1 unless this prompt names them. Do NOT redraw the scene, do NOT recolor globally, do NOT move or rescale anything beyond what is stated. Completely remove the replaced Regent parts (old brown/gold four-point hat-head, gold gauntlets, blue robe, armor) with no remnants left behind, and refill the cleared area with the original background shapes. Match the original's rich hard cel-shading: crisp dark outlines, deep near-black occlusion planes, clear midtone and lit planes, material thickness, purposeful small details; no blur, no soft glow, no photoreal rendering. Makoto Yuki's face and head never appear (hands and sleeves only); other characters' faces are allowed. Persona creatures' hands are plump cartoon mittens with no long human fingers. If a named character's design is uncertain, follow the described features, keep the rest simple, and never invent text. Keep important features inside x8-92%, y10-85% (crop-safe). Output: opaque, full-bleed, horizontal 1000x760, no text, letters, numbers, frame, UI or watermark. Replace ONLY the huge inverted Regent head at the top center (a wide brown hat pointing downward) with KOROMARU peeking down UPSIDE DOWN from a ledge just above the top edge of the frame: his two front paws hooked over the top edge, his head upside down at the top center, a small kunai held in his mouth pointing straight down at the blade below, alert eyes, his dark-red scarf hanging down. IMPORTANT: Koromaru is a normal small Shiba Inu. His head is only about 22% of the canvas width, much narrower than the old hat. His ears are two SMALL triangular Shiba ears pointing downward (because he is upside down). NO wings, NO bat ears, NO large spread flaps or fins of any kind on the head or body. The rest of the old hat's wide silhouette is NOT part of him: refill it with the original dark violet-blue background and its sparkles. Keep unchanged: the orange spiked eye blade at the bottom, the red laser lines, the dark violet-blue background. Character and object designs: [KOROMARU] = KOROMARU: a small white-and-cream Shiba Inu with a dark-red scarf and bright determined eyes.
